{{Quote|We're trying to bring Life Day to the less fortunate citizens.|Oolovv|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Oolovv''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] freedom fighter. He helped to organize the [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] festivities following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] in the towns of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]], and [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. He also rewarded people sympathetic to the cause of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] that helped in the preparations and realization of the festivities with various presents.

==Behind the scenes==
Oolovv was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. During the Life Day live event from [[December 16]], [[2008]] to [[January 12]], [[2009]], he could be found near the [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] of Dearic, Wayfar, and Doaba Guerfel. He returned for the Life Day events of 2009, 2010, and 2011.

For decorating [[Tree/Legends|trees]] throughout the cities, Rebel-aligned players were rewarded special Rebel Alliance Propaganda Tokens that could be redeemed for decorative items by talking to Oolovv. Imperial players had to talk to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Sstrigge]] instead.
